scope: Private positive reuse of already-admitted shared AST projections during atomic native staging. No new action, protocol, checkpoint family, default, native engine inverse or browser adapter.

contracts.currentProjection: Same live owner token, committed state and oplog versions only; pending and detached states miss. Protocol/header checks precede hits. Root namespaces, causal bytes, UI, history and journal limits still receive complete adoption checks, including empty root activation without a new operation.
contracts.retainedPrefix: Only the unchanged live owner's exact internal journal receives an immutable replay reader. Native commands, keys, UI and expected causal effects still replay. A hit re-admits the immutable AST under the active codec. Fresh JSON recovery has no reader, and staged construction removes its reader before any new action.
contracts.atomicity: Staged memo writes use copy-on-write; a failed action cannot mutate the published owner's store. Tests include a late publication failure followed by a different payload at the same prospective counter.
contracts.cacheLimits: At most 256 entries and 2 MiB charged canonical/key/entry allowance per store; 4096 combined clock entries maximum for cache eligibility. Oversized entries simply materialize normally. This charge is not a total heap budget; ASTs, allocator overhead, and old-source/candidate overlap need separate measurement.
contracts.compatibility: Original local runtime/browser/rich/editor package archives remain identical. Original shared models, checkpoints, errors, operation/frame semantics and exported method surface are unchanged. No dependency or vendored source change.
